evaluation.subset_caveat: Descriptive, nonrandom query groups defined by whether any candidate was truncated; not a causal estimate of truncation. Fixed denominators are retained within each group.

experiment_unique_ledger_at_snapshot.cost_definition: Unique ledger attempts across all scopes; cache reuse adds no cost. CAD includes recorded FX/fee/buffer, excludes any experiment fixed fee. Reservations may precede an unobserved transport attempt; held amounts are not claimed as settled charges.

logical_scope_unique_attempt_usage_do_no.cost_definition: Unique ledger attempts across all scopes; cache reuse adds no cost. CAD includes recorded FX/fee/buffer, excludes any experiment fixed fee. Reservations may precede an unobserved transport attempt; held amounts are not claimed as settled charges.
logical_scope_unique_attempt_usage_do_no.warning: Distinct attempts serving this logical scope, including earlier reused smoke calls. Never add this to another scope's totals.

wall_time.definition: Final receipts use original filesystem mtime as an end proxy after ingestion. Missing-final invocations use immutable checkpoint activity as a lower bound and an explicit reviewed recovery window when available; a reboot timestamp is only an upper bound, never an exact exit. No success or exit is inferred for missing finals. Invocation sums exclude gaps; experiment elapsed includes gaps and the six-hour deadline remains anchored at the first ledger reservation. Parent work before runner start is unmeasured; reused API duration is excluded from new API time. Wall-minus-recorded-settled-API residuals can include unknown in-flight API time; genuine non-API lower bounds are therefore zero when missing-final or unresolved-attempt evidence remains.

projection.uncertainty_policy: Extrapolate the complete scope's settled usage only. Add existing unresolved holds once to the experiment planning upper commitment; do not smear a historical unknown attempt into future per-query usage. Held amounts are allowances, not known charges. These cost bounds concern only existing held uncertainty under a linear settled-rate assumption, not prediction confidence intervals or guaranteed future bounds. Legacy scalar time fields carry the planning upper estimate (null if unbounded); interval fields preserve interruption uncertainty.
projection.caveat: Linear query-rate extrapolation; full-plan request mix and growing-ledger overhead can differ. Reused smoke responses can make the observed query wall rate optimistic for fresh queries. Timing bounds include incomplete invocation work and unknown in-flight time. CAD excludes any separate fixed experiment fee. No budget gate or six-hour guarantee is asserted or reset; an unknown hold remains unresolved and this report grants no retry or expansion permission. Scope reuse is counted once in experiment totals.
